t: The POOF Principle: Engineering AI Context in the Age of Amnesiac Genies
s: This article explains that LLMs lack persistent memory, treating each interaction as a fresh start. It proposes engineering the context window to manage AI's stateless nature, referencing projects like 'Pipulate' and custom scripts.
sub: LLM statelessness and lack of persistent memory
Engineering the context window for AI control
Misconceptions about AI memory and conversational continuity
The 'POOF' principle: AI state resets after each interaction
